items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: The band was incidental... We had a fellow there... His name was Kid Snead.

ctx.x: Well, it was mostly... The band was incidental. It was mostly entertainers. There were singers. We had a fellow there who did show numbers and things that people liked -- I mean, those Society people. Anything they named, he could sing it. His name was Kid Snead. And boy, he knew all of the numbers from Europe... You know how Bobby Short is today?
